title: Mechanism for Vetting of Individuals like Coaches or Volunteers for Roles Involving Unsupervised Access to Children
what_it_is: Mechanism for Vetting of Individuals like Coaches or Volunteers for Roles Involving Unsupervised Access to Children

sections.label: Screening for child contact roles
sections.summary: Regulated roles with sustained child contact are screened for past offences, including sexual offences, while unregulated sectors have no such requirement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Today, individuals applying for roles involving sustained contact with children and young persons are screened for past offences, including convictions for sexual offences, if these roles are regulated by public agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This includes those applying to be full-time mosque staff, recognised religious teachers under the Asatizah Recognition Scheme, employees in the Ministry of Education schools and Early Childhood Development Agency-licensed preschools, and members of Sport Singapore's National Registry of Coaches.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There is presently no requirement for employers in unregulated sectors to verify the criminal records of employees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government has been considering, for some time, the possible expansion of the scope of screening to cover more types of roles involving contact with children and young persons, including whether to introduce voluntary screening for unregulated sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This could take the form of a certificate-based system, which several Members have proposed, and the considerations include the practicability of such screening requirements and whether employers, primarily our small and medium enterprises, will be able to handle such screening requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, when it comes to such things, the safety of our children will have to take priority.
